meta.name: work-with-pr
meta.description: Full PR lifecycle in a fresh task-owned git worktree: implement via the ulw-loop skill with mandatory evidence-bound manual QA → reviewer-readable English PR → verification loop (CI + Cubic, where Cubic is skipped only when its quota is exhausted) → merge by default → worktree cleanup. Decomposes one task into the smallest atomic, independently-mergeable PRs and builds the independent ones concurrently via one worktree per PR driven by parallel subagents or a team. Unbounded loop: any failing gate sends you back to fix-and-re-QA inside that PR's worktree. Use whenever implementation work needs to land as a PR. Triggers: 'create a PR', 'implement and PR', 'work on this and make a PR', 'implement issue', 'land this as a PR', 'split into atomic PRs', 'parallel PRs', 'work-with-pr', 'PR workflow', 'implement end to end', even when user just says 'implement X' if the context implies PR delivery.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 拆分开发任务为多个独立小改动,自动验证后逐个合并上线。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你经常要把开发任务变成多个独立小改动,逐个通过验证并合入主分支。
copy.tagline_en: Turn one dev task into small verified changes that merge one by one.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often turn dev tasks into small changes requiring individual review and merge.

howto.what: 把任务拆成多个最小可独立合并的 PR,每个在独立 worktree 中实现;必须做有证据的人工验收后写出英文 PR,再进入 CI 与 Cubic 检查循环,全部通过后自动合并并清理工作目录。
howto.when: 当你要求“创建 PR”“实现并提交 PR”等涉及以 PR 交付的请求,或要把工作拆成原子 PR、并行开发时触发。

say.text: 把这个 issue 实现成 PR,先拆成最小的原子 PR。
say.note: 会先规划拆分再逐个执行。

say.text: 并行建 2 个独立 PR,各用单独 worktree。
say.note: 会派子代理并行推进各 PR。

say.text: 等 CI 和 Cubic 都通过就自动合并。
say.note: 会进入验证循环直到门禁通过。

howto.what_en: Turns a request into the full PR lifecycle: splits the task into the smallest independently mergeable PRs, implements each in its own worktree, requires evidence-bound manual QA, writes a reviewer-readable English PR, loops through CI and Cubic checks, auto-merges, and cleans up worktrees.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to create a PR, implement and PR, split into atomic PRs, or otherwise indicate work should land as a PR.

say_en.text: Implement this issue as a PR, split into the smallest atomic PRs first.
say_en.note: It will plan the split first, then execute.

say_en.text: Build 2 independent PRs in parallel, one worktree each.
say_en.note: Subagents will drive each PR concurrently.

say_en.text: Auto-merge once both CI and Cubic pass.
say_en.note: It enters the verification loop until all gates pass.
